items.text: LexiconProjectionAdapter trait: project_outbound(epr, target_lexicon)->Option<AtProtoRecord> and project_inbound(record)->Option<IngestSignal>; AtProtoRecord/IngestSignal opaque to the trait
ProjectionAttestation trait: attest(record, source, scope)->ProjectionClaim — doorway signs as relying party, peer never appears as AT Proto signer

Outbound projection: publish selected peer-native EPRs into AT Proto Firehose as lexicon records, doorway-signed with ProjectionClaim referencing source EPR content-handle; opt-in per EPR variant via federation manifest
Inbound ingest: subscribe to a Firehose slice, translate records to protocol ingest signals registered against doorway content registry; peers subscribe by manifest (inside-out, no push)
Inbound attribution: ingest signals carry original did:plc reference + doorway translation claim but do NOT import did:plc as peer-native identity; foreign standing, no constitutional-floor admission
Federation manifest declares which EPR variants project to which lexicons (manifest-driven routes); conservative defaults — outbound opt-in
Lexicon mapping v1 shortlist: org.dds.result.pca + org.dds.result.summary outbound; org.dds.module.polis + org.dds.module.sense inbound (concrete mappings are implementations)
Open: ProjectionClaim hash anchoring — content-addressed vs URI reference (probably content-addressed; defer to first impl)
Open: inbound Sybil hardening — per-publisher rate limits in federation manifest against ingest-amplification flooding
Open: multi-doorway dedup semantics when same EPR projected outbound by two operators with two ProjectionClaims
Open: ActivityPub generalization — when trait surface generalizes from AtProtoRecord to LexiconRecord<L> parameterized over federation flavor
